notes:
Topline: SaaS knowledge-base RAG for high-volume support chat + internal KB search. Priorities = embeddings quality + reranker performance at scale, predictable per-query cost.

Context / org: Growing mid-market helpdesk platform; 600 employees, US HQ, servicing customers in NA/EU. Heavy spike patterns (weekday morning + product release windows) -> bursty QPS up to ~1k QPS for search endpoints.

Recent conversations:
- 2026-01-27 kickoff with AE/SE (Avery / Jordan). Client: Head of Platform (Maria Chen) + Principal SRE (Dinesh Patel).
- They said: "We need sub-100ms median on read path for 8k token contexts and re-ranker in <= 50ms per candidate." Wants end-to-end SLA for hosted option before considering Dedicated.
- SE asked about index size: currently ~18M docs (KB articles + user transcripts), expect 2-3x growth in 12 months. Typical vector dims 1536.

Tech requirements / asks:
- Embedding throughput: ingest pipeline at ~300 inserts/sec sustained, bulk backfill ~10M docs over 2 weeks.
- Query latency: median 80-120ms target (depends on embeddings + top-k rerank). Must support batching and async fallback.
- Cost sensitivity: target <= $0.0025 per query (embeddings+rerank amortized). Willing to trade token costs vs latency if clear SLAs/controls.
- Model prefs: prefer open models for embeddings (cost) + Redwood routing to smaller reranker models for latency-sensitive routes.

Security / compliance: SOC2 expected, want SSO (SAML) + audit logs + contractual data residency for EU customers. Will need DPA + KMS options if we move to private later.

POC plan (agreed):
- Phase 1: Hosted API POC (2 weeks) — ingest 5M doc sample, run mixed QPS tests up to 1k, measure median latency, top-k recall, cost per query.
- Phase 2: Canary evaluation (2 weeks) — live traffic shadowing for selected customers, rollback policies, fallback to legacy search.
- Success criteria: median query latency <= 120ms at 1k QPS; reranker latency <= 50ms for top-10; embedding recall delta < 2% vs current baseline; cost per query < $0.003.

- Asked for demo of prefix/KV caching and how it reduces billable tokens. Client liked the cache demo.
- Legal requested sample DPA — attached in Drive.
